ValidationRule.description: When the Opportunity is moving to closed Won, its primary product and Client for life should be in sync with Primary Product and Client for life of its Primary Quote
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR(TEXT(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c)<> TEXT( SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.NSP_Opportunity_Primary_Product__c ), TEXT( NSP_Client_For_Life__c ) <> TEXT( SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.NSP_Client_For_Life__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "WO")), NOT(OR( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator" , $Profile.Name = "Data Migration", $Profile.Name = "Sales Administrator")), NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.OpportunityTrigger__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update the Primary Product and Client for life on the opportunity that matches the quote
